description: This file defines the 'Schema' class and related metaclass and options for marshmallow serialization/deserialization library, including schema validation, field handling, and processing hooks.

classes.name: SchemaMeta
classes.description: Metaclass for the Schema class, handling field inheritance, class options, and hook resolution.

classes.name: SchemaOpts
classes.description: Class for schema options, including fields, exclude, formats, and other configuration.

classes.name: Schema
classes.description: Base class for defining marshmallow schemas, including serialization, deserialization, validation, and hook management.

methods.name: from_dict
methods.description: Generates a Schema class from a dictionary of fields.

methods.name: handle_error
methods.description: Custom error handler for validation errors.

methods.name: get_attribute
methods.description: Defines how to extract attribute values from objects for serialization.

methods.name: _call_and_store
methods.description: Calls a getter function and stores validation errors.

methods.name: _serialize
methods.description: Serializes an object or collection into a dictionary.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Serializes an object to native Python data types.

methods.name: dumps
methods.description: Serializes an object to a JSON string.

methods.name: _deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data into Python objects, handling errors and partial loading.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Deserializes data into a Python object according to schema fields.

methods.name: loads
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a Python object.

methods.name: _run_validator
methods.description: Runs a schema validator and stores errors if validation fails.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates data against the schema, returning errors if any.

methods.name: _do_load
methods.description: Private method to handle full deserialization process, including hooks and validation.

methods.name: _normalize_nested_options
methods.description: Flattens nested schema options for 'only' and 'exclude'.

methods.name: __apply_nested_option
methods.description: Applies nested options to nested fields based on set operations.

methods.name: _init_fields
methods.description: Initializes schema fields based on options, including validation for conflicts.

methods.name: on_bind_field
methods.description: Hook for modifying a field when bound to the schema.

methods.name: _bind_field
methods.description: Binds a field to the schema, setting attributes like load_only and dump_only.

methods.name: _invoke_dump_processors
methods.description: Runs pre- and post-dump processing hooks.

methods.name: _invoke_load_processors
methods.description: Runs pre- and post-load processing hooks.

methods.name: _invoke_field_validators
methods.description: Runs field-level validators.

methods.name: _invoke_schema_validators
methods.description: Runs schema-level validators.

methods.name: _invoke_processors
methods.description: Runs custom hook processors for serialization/deserialization.
